question: ¿Cuántas concesiones tienen al menos un posible venteo detectado por satélite desde el 1 de enero de 2024 dentro de su contorno y tienen el gasoducto de transporte de ENARGAS más cercano a 10 km o más de su contorno?

attempts.query: WITH c AS (SELECT id_concesion, anillo::jsonb AS a FROM sig_energia.concesion WHERE anillo IS NOT NULL AND anillo <> ''), cv AS (SELECT c.id_concesion, (t.p->>0)::float8 AS x, (t.p->>1)::float8 AS y, t.i FROM c, jsonb_array_elements(c.a) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(p, i)), ce AS (SELECT id_concesion, x AS x1, y AS y1, COALESCE(LEAD(x) OVER w, FIRST_VALUE(x) OVER w) AS x2, COALESCE(LEAD(y) OVER w, FIRST_VALUE(y) OVER w) AS y2 FROM cv WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY id_concesion ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)), v AS (SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND lon IS NOT NULL AND lat IS NOT NULL), dentro AS (SELECT ce.id_concesion, v.gml_id FROM ce JOIN v ON ((ce.y1 > v.lat) <> (ce.y2 > v.lat)) AND v.lon < (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * (v.lat - ce.y1) / (ce.y2 - ce.y1) + ce.x1 GROUP BY ce.id_concesion, v.gml_id HAVING COUNT(*) % 2 = 1), cand AS (SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM dentro), gp AS (SELECT g.gml_id, l.j, (t.p->>0)::float8 AS x, (t.p->>1)::float8 AS y, t.i FROM enargas.gasoducto g, jsonb_array_elements(g.lineas::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS l(line, j), jsonb_array_elements(l.line) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(p, i) WHERE g.lineas IS NOT NULL AND g.lineas <> ''), gs AS (SELECT x AS x1, y AS y1, LEAD(x) OVER w AS x2, LEAD(y) OVER w AS y2 FROM gp WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY gml_id, j ORDER BY i)), seg AS (SELECT x1, y1, COALESCE(x2, x1) AS x2, COALESCE(y2, y1) AS y2 FROM gs), d AS (SELECT cv.id_concesion, (cv.x - s.x1) * 111.32 * cos(radians(cv.y)) AS px, (cv.y - s.y1) * 110.574 AS py, (s.x2 - s.x1) * 111.32 * cos(radians(cv.y)) AS dx, (s.y2 - s.y1) * 110.574 AS dy FROM cv JOIN cand ON cand.id_concesion = cv.id_concesion CROSS JOIN seg s), dd AS (SELECT id_concesion, px, py, dx, dy, GREATEST(0, LEAST(1, COALESCE((px * dx + py * dy) / NULLIF(dx * dx + dy * dy, 0), 0))) AS t FROM d), dist AS (SELECT id_concesion, MIN(sqrt(power(px - t * dx, 2) + power(py - t * dy, 2))) AS km FROM dd GROUP BY id_concesion) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dist WHERE km >= 10
